title: Accessibility | Apple Developer Documentation - [Mobility](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility\#Mobility)
claim: Let people use Voice Control to give guidance and enter information verbally.** With Voice Control, people can interact with their devices entirely by speaking commands. They can perform gestures, interact with screen elements, dictate and edit text, and more. To ensure a smooth experience, label interface elements appropriately. For developer guidance, see [Voice Control](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/accessibility/voice-control).
